input.comment: [Playbook] We have deleted the most-favoured-nation obligation in Section 7.2: our playbook does not permit us to accept an open-ended commitment to extend Vendor the best terms we give any other supplier, and it conflicts with Section 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges we have made no most-favoured-customer commitment. If some price assurance is important, we could discuss a narrow MFN limited to a defined product for 12 months with reasonable-comparison carve-outs.
input.summary: Delete Customer-side MFN obligation in Section 7.2.
